description: Community Aerodrome Locations (DOT-039) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport. Community airport or aerodrome locations depicting the Regional Airports Development Scheme funded by the Department of Transport, Western Australia. The sites include indigenous airstrip locations, as well as Local, State and Commonwealth Government airport locations. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Transport. Its tags are Aviation, Regional Airports Development Scheme. It offers 4 resource(s) in .ZIP SHAPEFILE, FILE GEODATABASE, MAPINFO MID/MIF, API ARCGIS SERVER MAP SERVICE, WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
